mapper.select: SELECT isbn13, title, authors, publisher, publication_year, class_no, class_name, description, image_url, fetched_at FROM book WHERE isbn13 = #{isbn13}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( isbn13, title, authors, publisher, publication_year, class_no, class_name, description, image_url ) VALUES ( #{isbn13}, #{title}, #{authors}, #{publisher}, #{publicationYear}, #{classNo}, #{className}, #{description}, #{imageUrl} ) ON CONFLICT (isbn13) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, authors = EXCLUDED.authors, publisher = EXCLUDED.publisher, publication_year = EXCLUDED.publication_year, class_no = EXCLUDED.class_no, class_name = EXCLUDED.class_name, description = EXCLUDED.description, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, fetched_at = now()
